prompt: Background extraction ONLY. This sprite sheet already has the correct people, clothes and poses. Remove ALL brown/orange gradient background, halos, haze and square patches between and around every figure, including the translucent background contamination. Deliver clean cutout figures on genuine transparent alpha (alpha zero in empty space), preserving soft anti-aliasing only on the actual hair/skin/clothing edges. Do not paint white/black/checkerboard behind them. Preserve EVERY figure and held object exactly at the same coordinates and size. Do not change faces, expressions, head size, proportions, clothing, hand poses, shoes, frame arrangement or canvas dimensions. No glow, shadow, outlines or colored veil around cutouts.
